title: 第三十八章 玄稷 炼丹那么简单看看就会了第三十七章 邪修拦路
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 秦征弋正被小徒弟感动的稀里哗啦的，见小徒弟突然被那妖邪给吸了过去，而他自己布置什么时候被困在阵法里，怒极。
“你敢动她，我现在就自爆！”
秦征弋已经做好自爆的准备。
他到底是个合体期修士，自爆那阵法肯定是直接摧毁不说，就是邪修不可能完全躲开。
大胖小胖还有壮壮甚至小黑都一窝蜂的朝着斜修扑过来要抢回他们的小主人然而修为最高不过大胖才是金丹后期的修为都不够那些修一脚踢的直接四小子四三飞开全都吐血倒地昏迷不醒看着玄霁眼睛都红了。
“啊——我杀了你！杀了你！”
玄稷心疼的不行！
邪修一手掐着乱蹬腿的玄稷，就像拎小鸡似的，玄稷用尽全力击打他，也就想挠痒痒。
毕竟修为差距实在是太大了。
“别急嘛，这小家互殴实在是太香了，只要你答应给我炼制丹药，我现在是不会动她的。”
邪修说着伸手抹了玄稷的血，正要放嘴里舔时，突然感觉手指如同被岩浆灼烧。
玄稷早不是之前懵懂无知，成为金丹修士后，神识聪慧不少，比如看坏人不再是靠闻味道。
她想起自己第一次被邪修给抓去的时候，邪修就是喝了自己的血，然后就被雷劈没了，她直接抓了一把下巴上的血，塞进了那邪修的嘴里，愤怒的看着他。
“你死定了！你去死吧！”
果然下一刻，邪修头顶上聚集了天雷。
邪修到底是合体期的，也在雷劫出现的第一时间发现，直觉和手里的小娃有关系，下意识把玄稷给甩了出去。
他想要把嘴巴里和手上沾到的鲜血给逼出来，结果无济于事。
因为雷劫比他动作更快，直接朝着他头顶直劈而下。
但到底是个合体期的修士，竟然硬是扛下了第一道雷劫，只是吐了口鲜血，刚好把玄稷的那点血也给吐出来。
赶紧把身体里残余的那丝正在灼烧他五脏六腑的血，也全都裹了清了出去。
手指上沾染的血，已经把他手指头灼烧的都烂到了骨头，血液还在继续腐蚀他的血肉，邪修也是当机立断的直接剁了那根手指。
同时天上的雷罚也退下去了。
更让邪修降压的是，眼睁睁看到那小娃的血，竟然没有落到地上，而是又回到了小娃的体内。
邪修看着玄稷，眼里露出贪婪。
“哈哈哈……受天道庇佑的小崽子！
果然不是个正常人！”
秦征弋在壮壮的帮助下，终于出来，第一时间抱起玄稷，心疼的不行。
“乖徒你怎么那么犟！”
让她走不走，现在他们师徒一个也别想走了。
自己明显就不是那邪修的对手。
没看他刚才连天罚都能硬扛下一道。
那邪修到底是个什么玩意儿，连天罚雷都不怕？
邪修不是最怕雷的吗？？
下一刻，邪修直接扬起那面万魂幡，把秦征弋和玄稷连同大胖它们四只兽，全都收了进去。
下一刻，邪修消失在原地。
只在他消失没一会儿，范沐禾杀气腾腾的出现了，身后跟着扛着星枢真人的慕狱。
慕狱跑得快断气了，尊上实在是太快了。
“小公主他们呢？”
“被邪修掳走了！”
“这老头儿怎么还不醒？
赶紧想办法把他弄醒，让他赶紧算他们被弄去哪了？！”
范沐禾就知道秦正义是个不靠谱的，真是个没用的东西！
她只知道是邪修掳走小公主他们，但那邪修却有手段让自己都察觉不到，把他们给带去哪里了。
content_en:
Qin Zhengyi was in an uproar when he was moved by his little apprentice. When he saw that his little apprentice was suddenly sucked in by the evil spirit, and he himself planned to be trapped in the formation at any time, he was extremely angry.
"If you dare to touch her, I will blow myself up right now!"
Qin Zhengyi was ready to self-destruct.
After all, he is a monk in the integration stage. The self-destruction formation must have been directly destroyed, and the evil cultivator cannot completely avoid it.
Big Fatty, Little Fatty, Zhuangzhuang and even Little Hei all swarmed towards Xianxiu to snatch back their little master. However, Big Fatty was the highest cultivation level, but Big Fatty was the late Jindan. His cultivation level was not enough. Those Xiu kicked him and the four boys flew away. They all vomited blood and fell to the ground unconscious. Looking at Xuan Ji, his eyes were red.
"Ah - I'll kill you! Kill you!"
Xuan Ji felt extremely distressed!
Xie Xiu pinched Xuan Ji, who was kicking his legs, with one hand, like he was carrying a chicken. Xuan Ji hit him with all his strength, just to scratch his itch.
After all, the gap in cultivation is really too big.
"Don't worry, this little family is so good at fighting each other. As long as you promise to refine the elixir for me, I won't touch her now."
Xie Xiu said, reaching out and wiping Xuan Ji's blood, and when he was about to put it in his mouth to lick it, he suddenly felt as if his fingers were being burned by magma.
Xuan Ji was no longer ignorant as before. After becoming a golden elixir monk, his spiritual consciousness became much smarter. For example, he no longer relied on smell to see bad people.
She remembered the first time she was captured by the evil cultivator. The evil cultivator drank her own blood and was struck by lightning. She directly grabbed a handful of blood from her chin, stuffed it into the evil cultivator's mouth, and looked at him angrily.
"You're dead! Go die!"
Sure enough, the next moment, thunder gathered above Xie Xiu's head.
After all, Xie Xiu was in the combined stage, and he immediately discovered when Lei Jie appeared that his intuition was related to the baby in his hand, and subconsciously threw Xuan Ji out.
He tried to force the blood out of his mouth and hands, but to no avail.
Because the thunder calamity moved faster than him, it struck directly at the top of his head.
But after all, he was a monk in the integration stage, and he actually withstood the first lightning tribulation, and he just spit out a mouthful of blood, just enough to spit out Xuan Ji's blood.
He quickly wrapped up all the remaining blood in his body that was burning his internal organs.
The blood stained on his fingers had burned them to the bone. The blood was still corroding his flesh and blood. The evil cultivator immediately chopped off the finger.
At the same time, the thunder punishment in the sky also receded.
What made Xie Xiu even more depressed was that he saw that the little baby's blood did not fall to the ground, but returned to the little baby's body.
Xie Xiu looked at Xuan Ji with greed in his eyes.
"Hahaha...little bastard blessed by heaven!
Sure enough, he is not a normal person! "
With Zhuang Zhuang's help, Qin Zhengyi finally came out and immediately picked up Xuan Ji, feeling extremely distressed.
"My dear disciple, why are you so stubborn!"
If she can't leave, none of them, master and disciple, can even think of leaving now.
He was obviously no match for that evil cultivator.
I didn't expect him to be able to withstand a heavenly punishment just now.
What kind of thing is that evil cultivator, who is not even afraid of the thunder of punishment from heaven?
Aren’t evil cultivators most afraid of thunder? ?
The next moment, the evil cultivator raised the Ten Thousand Souls Flag and took in Qin Zhengyi, Xuan Ji, Da Pang and the other four beasts.
The next moment, the evil cultivator disappeared.
Not long after he disappeared, Fan Muhe appeared with murderous intent, followed by Mu Yu who was carrying Master Xingshu.
Mu Yu ran almost to death, Your Majesty was too fast.
"Where are the little princess and the others?"
"Abducted by evil cultivators!"
"Why isn't this old man awake?
Quickly find a way to wake him up and let him quickly figure out where they were taken? ! "
Fan Muhe knew that Qin Zhengyi was unreliable and useless!
She only knew that the evil cultivator had kidnapped the little princess and the others, but that evil cultivator had a way of taking them wherever she was unaware.
